C-HOSTED-VALIDATION-RECOVERY.Name: Preserve Find focus during collapsed selection updates and restore Linux CI dependency fetches
C-HOSTED-VALIDATION-RECOVERY.ApprovalBasis: Owner-requested green-main stabilization and ordinary integration delegation. Required CI at PR211 head3d54d2b exposed a reproducible selection-to-empty-Find feedback loop and repeated HTTP Azure Ubuntu mirror timeouts before backend tests.
C-HOSTED-VALIDATION-RECOVERY.Summary: A collapsed editor selection must not replace a valid Find query with an empty value and schedule a focus-losing rerender. Hosted Ubuntu dependencies use the canonical HTTPS Ubuntu mirror when the image config names the stalled Azure HTTP mirror.

Goals.Goal: Preserve the current Find query/matches and editor caret when a selection collapses; retain nonempty selected-text prefill and native menu synchronization. The unchanged progressive navigation oracle passes through tail completion.
Canonicalize only the Azure HTTP Ubuntu source URI in ephemeral Linux CI sources before apt update; preserve signed suites/components, package selection, retries and budgets.

Constraints.Item: No table/viewer repair changes, acceptance expansion, version, tag, publication, threshold, timeout, retry or skip changes. No changes to local machine package sources. Existing artifact-bound owner acceptance remains scoped.

NonGoals.Item: No progressive scheduler redesign, new search behavior, native window change or release.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red/green collapsed-selection regression preserves the full Find object while still sending menu state; nonempty selection prefill remains. Full renderer coverage and unchanged WebKit-perf and table/viewer suites pass.
The CI-only URI rewrite leaves nonmatching source text intact and the shell remains valid. A fresh exact-head hosted run must pass before merge.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-011 editor store and M-046 test workflow; existing M-063 navigation scenario is verification evidence, not an implementation change.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Direct regression, full renderer coverage, production build, unchanged full WebKit-perf and table/viewer gates, syntax/fixture check of the mirror rewrite, fresh hosted checks.
